integrity: Analytic cyclic Green-kernel proof; exact symbolic identity and independent finite rational Gram checks. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real continuous periodic piecewise-linear splines with a positive two-period knot mesh, m >= 2. The infinite-cell limit fixes positive a and b. No claims about arbitrary knot patterns, higher-degree splines, or nonperiodic endpoints. Earlier Gram-kernel and general boundedness results are credited.
title: Exact two-periodic spline projection norms and a quadratic mesh-contrast law
